skills.desc: Releases a rift pulse at the enemy. Inflicts the enemy with DEF Down for 1 turn with a 25% chance.

skills.name: Void Gaze
skills.desc: Increases self ATK by 2% after using Rift Pulse. Stacks up to 5 times.

name: Watchkeeper
desc: Something altered by the Void. Its original form is unrecognizable.

skills.name: Mad Wingbeats
skills.desc: Condenses energy through the entire body and detonates it at the enemy's location. Has a 75% chance to inflict the enemy with ATK Down for 1 turn.

skills.name: Twisted Gaze
skills.desc: Triggers Mad Wingbeats after being attacked by an attack that targets all. Prioritizes attacking the attacker. Occurs once every 3 turns.

name: Woodpicker
desc: Description of Woodpicker.

skills.name: Woodcutter Sphere
skills.desc: Fires a precision rocket at the enemy. Inflicts the enemy with Bleed for 1 turn with a 75% chance.

skills.name: Full Barrage
skills.desc: Launches multi-rocket barrages at all enemies. Inflicts all enemies with ACC Down for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

name: Worshipper
desc: An ancient structure of unknown origins. Best not to approach unless you're confident in your skills.

skills.name: Void Lightning
skills.desc: Fires Void Lightning at the enemy. Inflicts the enemy with ACC Down for 1 turn with a 25% chance.

skills.name: Overcharge
skills.desc: Grants self CRIT Rate Up for 1 turn at the start of battle.
